crossRefs.note: “ ‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
“Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is…
You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I…
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…

translations.web: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
translations.bsb: If any man among you becomes unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he must leave the camp and stay outside.
translations.kjv: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
translations.asv: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of that which chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
